classification_rules.FACT: Bound source text/code or saved receipt observation; no causal/economic extrapolation
classification_rules.HYPOTHESIS: Mechanism/payer/falsifier requiring later separately authorized evidence
classification_rules.SOURCE_CLAIM: External author or archived model extraction claim, not local PASS

metric_semantics: All economic numbers are copied from saved receipts; zero strategy execution, economic replay, parameter search, or economic audit rerun in this task.
Periods differ by lane; this is a mechanism/evidence benchmark, not a normalized profitability leaderboard.
Summed equal-entry-notional trade-bps and realized cohort drawdown are not account return, NAV drawdown, liquidation or mark-to-market proof.
Historical 1m-to-15m/30m completed UTC bars preserve gaps; BAR_CLOSE_MODEL availability is a historical assumption, not measured real-time delivery. Historical volume units remain UNKNOWN.
Reference cost1x/cost2x are frozen scenario repricing of unchanged fills; cost2x is not leverage and neither scenario is actual historical taker fills.
Win/loss, MFE/MAE, retained winner and outcome labels below are post-outcome diagnostics and cannot be entry observables.
OHLC stop-first and next-open rules are conservative research conventions; they do not reconstruct intrabar paths or certify marketable fills.
No authority to implement a strategy, create a child, run economics, claim a slot, schedule work, trade, deploy or promote follows from this document.
